checks.detail: Schema violations in the top-level animation object: ip is missing; w must be an integer of at least 0; fr must be a number above 0; 1 layer is not an object; nm must be a string; markers must be an array; slots must be an object. Schema: https://lottie.github.io/lottie-spec/1.0.1/lottie.schema.json.

checks.name: Required fields present (v, fr, ip, op, w, h, layers)
checks.detail: Required fields missing: ip. The contract requires v, fr, ip, op, w, h, layers.

checks.name: No deprecated Bodymovin version (v: "4.x")
checks.detail: Bodymovin version: v is "4.8.0", a 4.x export, which is deprecated: re-export with an exporter that follows the Lottie spec.

checks.name: markers array present (reduced-motion support)
checks.detail: No markers array, so a player has no named segment to choose for reduced motion.

checks.name: meta object present (attribution, author, description)
checks.detail: No meta object, so the file carries no attribution, author or description (an attribution gap).

checks.name: prefers-reduced-motion path documented (§3.4)
checks.detail: No reduced-motion path documented: no marker or slot is named for reduced motion (reduced, calm, static, still, no-motion), and meta does not note an external prefers-reduced-motion wrapper.

checks.name: Easing uses deliberate curves (§16.1, §16.10)
checks.detail: Easing: no eased keyframes to check (2 layers, no animated property with bezier handles), so §16.1 (Easing is deliberate) and §16.10 (Easing is never ease-in) have nothing to test.

checks.name: Duration ≤ 300ms for UI motion (§16.7)
checks.detail: Duration cannot be computed: it needs fr above 0 and op greater than ip (fr 0, ip missing, op 12).

checks.name: No layout-property animation (§16.5)
checks.detail: Not applicable to a Lottie file: §16.5 (Layout is not animated) concerns CSS layout properties (width, height, margin, padding, top, left), and a Lottie file has none; it animates transforms, opacity and vector shapes inside its own canvas. Check the page that embeds it with designesy_score.

checks.name: No motion on keyboard-initiated actions (§16.4)
checks.detail: Not applicable to a Lottie file: §16.4 (Keyboard is still) concerns what starts playback, and whether a keyboard action starts it is decided by the page that embeds the file. Check that page with designesy_score.

ten_non_negotiable.detail: Use contract cubicBezier tokens instead of bare CSS keywords
Never transition:all. Name exact properties.
Animate from scale(0.9-0.97) + opacity, never scale(0)
No motion on keyboard-initiated or high-frequency interactions
Never animate width/height/margin/padding/top/left. Use transform/opacity.
:hover motion on touch surfaces requires explicit gating
UI animation ≤ 300ms unless justified
Every animation has prefers-reduced-motion path
Press and release use asymmetric timing
No ease-in. Deceleration (ease-out) or custom curves only.
